name: GitHub Kanban Pipeline (Aider → Qdrant Sync → Human Review Gate)

parameters.command:
docker exec -i kanban-runner bash -c '
set -e
cd /workspace

# Sync Qdrant context before starting
python3 scripts/populate_qdrant.py 2>/dev/null || echo "Qdrant sync skipped (running on prod)"

# Create or check out issue branch
git fetch origin 2>/dev/null || true
git checkout issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }} 2>/dev/null || git checkout -b issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }}

# Run aider using the external LiteLLM gateway (ai.sous.tools)
# --model openai/<model-name> with openai-api-base pointing to LiteLLM
# drop_params is set in litellm_config.yaml so tool_calls work with Ollama
aider \
  --model openai/coder \
  --openai-api-base https://ai.sous.tools/v1 \
  --openai-api-key sk-1234 \
  --edit-format diff \
  --no-auto-commits \
  --yes \
  --message "[TASK]: {{ $json.issueTitle }}.
[DETAILS]: {{ $json.issueBody }}

Rules:
1. Read AGENTS.md for architectural constraints.
2. Query Qdrant MCP (sous_tools_memory + sous_tools_adrs) for relevant ADRs/context FIRST.
3. Implement minimal, focused changes that satisfy the task requirements.
4. Respect all DDD boundaries, Supabase firewall, and Container/View patterns.
5. If you are blocked or missing critical information, output EXACTLY: NEEDS_INPUT: <your specific question> and stop immediately without modifying any files.

Output only code diffs. No conversational text."

# Quality gate
TEST_OUTPUT=$(pnpm turbo typecheck 2>&1 && pnpm turbo lint 2>&1 && INFISICAL_MOCK=true pnpm turbo test 2>&1)

# Commit and push
git add .
git commit -m "feat(issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }}): {{ $json.issueTitle }}"
git push origin issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }}

# Create PR
PR_URL=$(gh pr create \
  --base main \
  --head issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }} \
  --title "feat(#{{ $json.issueNumber }}): {{ $json.issueTitle }}" \
  --body "Resolves #{{ $json.issueNumber }}

## Test Results
\`\`\`
${TEST_OUTPUT}
\`\`\`" 2>/dev/null || gh pr view issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }} --json url -q .url)

# Sync Qdrant after completion
python3 scripts/populate_qdrant.py 2>/dev/null || true

echo "PR: $PR_URL"
'

docker exec -i kanban-runner bash -c '
set -e
cd /workspace
git fetch origin 2>/dev/null || true
git checkout issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }} 2>/dev/null || git checkout -b issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }}

aider \
  --model openai/coder \
  --openai-api-base https://ai.sous.tools/v1 \
  --openai-api-key sk-1234 \
  --edit-format diff \
  --no-auto-commits \
  --yes \
  --message "[HUMAN RESPONSE TO YOUR PREVIOUS QUESTION]: {{ $json.commentBody }}

Using this information, complete the task: {{ $json.issueTitle }}

Rules: Strictly implement minimal code following AGENTS.md. No conversational output."

TEST_OUTPUT=$(pnpm turbo typecheck 2>&1 && pnpm turbo lint 2>&1 && INFISICAL_MOCK=true pnpm turbo test 2>&1)

git add . && git commit -m "fix(issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }}): apply human feedback"
git push origin issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }}

PR_URL=$(gh pr view issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }} --json url -q .url 2>/dev/null || gh pr create --base main --head issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }} --title "fix(#{{ $json.issueNumber }}): {{ $json.issueTitle }}" --body "Resolves #{{ $json.issueNumber }}

## Test Results
\`\`\`
${TEST_OUTPUT}
\`\`\`")

python3 scripts/populate_qdrant.py 2>/dev/null || true
echo "PR: $PR_URL"
'

parameters.name: body

parameters.text:
=🔍 **PR Ready for Human Review**

Issue #{{ $('Parse GitHub Payload').item.json.issueNumber }}: **{{ $('Parse GitHub Payload').item.json.issueTitle }}**

✅ Typecheck, lint, and tests passed.
📋 Please review the PR, verify the changes, and move the Kanban card to **Done** to auto-merge.

=🔔 **Agent Blocked — Human Input Required**

Issue #{{ $('Parse GitHub Payload').item.json.issueNumber }}: **{{ $('Parse GitHub Payload').item.json.issueTitle }}**

❓ {{ $json.agentQuestion }}

A comment has been posted on the GitHub issue. Reply there to unblock the agent.

parameters.command:
docker exec -i kanban-runner bash -c '
set -e
cd /workspace
git checkout main
git pull origin main

# Merge PR via gh CLI
gh pr merge issue-{{ $('Parse GitHub Payload').item.json.issueNumber }} --merge --delete-branch 2>/dev/null || (
  git merge issue-{{ $('Parse GitHub Payload').item.json.issueNumber }} &&
  git push origin main &&
  git branch -d issue-{{ $('Parse GitHub Payload').item.json.issueNumber }} &&
  git push origin --delete issue-{{ $('Parse GitHub Payload').item.json.issueNumber }} 2>/dev/null || true
)

# Final Qdrant sync after merge
python3 scripts/populate_qdrant.py 2>/dev/null || true

echo "✅ Issue #{{ $json.issueNumber }} merged and branch cleaned"
'
